1-Bedroom Apartment | High Floor | Burj & Coca-Cola Arena View | Verve City Walk – Tower A

Exceptional 1-bedroom apartment in Verve City Walk – Tower A, located in the vibrant heart of City Walk.

Spanning 833.98 sq.ft., this high-floor unit offers a well-designed layout with a spacious living and dining area, modern open-plan kitchen, and a generously sized bedroom finished to premium standards. Floor-to-ceiling windows allow for abundant natural light and showcase stunning views of Burj Khalifa and Coca-Cola Arena.

Verve at City Walk delivers contemporary urban living with resort-style amenities, including a swimming pool, state-of-the-art gym, landscaped relaxation areas, and immediate access to high-end retail, fine dining, and entertainment venues.

Lifestyle & Recreation

Resort-style swimming pool with sun deck and lap area
Children’s pool and kids play area
Outdoor BBQ & seating areas
Kids playground with climbing walls and slides

Convenience & Security

24/7 security and concierge services
Reflective water features and private courtyards

Community & Connectivity


Direct access to City Walk retail, cafés, and dining options

Retail outlets, restaurants, and entertainment within the wider City Walk district
